chunks: What Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from Ismāʿīl ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿarī, who said:

I asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a man who touches the private part of his slave-girl until she emits fluid, without intercourse, playing with her by his hand until she emits. He said: If she emits from desire, then ghusl is upon her.

key_terms.الْغُسْلُ: the ritual bath made obligatory after a state of janabah

ai.seo_question: Does ghusl become obligatory for a woman if she emits fluid from desire without intercourse?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning ghusl for a woman who emits fluid due to sexual desire, even without direct intercourse. It indicates that the cause of ghusl here is sexual emission arising from shahwah, whether in wakefulness or otherwise.
